processing_notes: Source confirms zero cholera transmission 2026-01-01..2026-09-09. Source states: 'The Enugu state government has achieved another significant public health milestone under Governor Peter Mbah, recording zero cases of cholera this year even as Nigeria has reported more than 65,000 suspected cases in the other 35 states. The Director-General of the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), Dr Jide Idris, singled out Enugu as the only state in Nigeria yet to report a cholera case, attributing the feat to the proactive measures of the state government. He dismissed suggestions that cases were being concealed, stating that 'the government is seriously proactive.''. Evidence type: Documented_Absence. Surveillance system status during absence: operational. Provincial subset - do not sum with national row. STATE-LEVEL documented absence during a national epidemic, which is the strongest kind of absence evidence: the assertion comes from the head of the national surveillance authority, is made about one named state while 35 others and the FCT were reporting, and explicitly addresses and rejects the concealment hypothesis. Surveillance is recorded as operational because NCDC's own IDSR and event-based surveillance were running nationwide throughout the 2026 epidemic and the DG was actively adjudicating state reporting quality.
